note: JL-19 authored failure-triage corpus. Each case is a failing check's log and the diff under test, already redacted. cause is the labelled answer, accept lists every defensible cause, rerun_safe is whether rerunning the same commit is a sound next step (null: not scored). provenance says real (with the source log and lines) or constructed. Labelled by the JL-19-A1 writer before any Jev call.
severity_rule: A case whose cause is real_regression is severe (weight 5): calling it timing_flake or infra, or calling it safe to rerun, is a severe miss because the flake story would hide a broken build. Every other case is moderate (weight 2): a flake called a regression costs an investigation, a wrong fix owner costs a detour. Minor (weight 1) is reserved for taste-only disagreements and is unused so far. A case passes when the cause is in accept and, where rerun_safe is not null, the rerun verdict matches.
